title: Concept: Predictable generator use (c) — review required
description: In c, n = rand() exposes a predictable generator. Default seeds and observable state make every output guessable, which is fine for sampling but fatal for tokens. The c-specific remedy is arc4random().
applicability: c codebases instantiating or reading the generator; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed security values; LOW default severity because these forms are often test-only, raised when the value guards access.
